method: Free public web search retrieval; English-language query strings. Search service did not expose a verifiable region setting, full result count, stable ranking, or query-level search volume.

queries.query: "educational adventure games for tweens" OR "educational games for 10-13 year olds"

observedResults.title: NomiPlay: Educational Games for Kids and Teens

observedResults.observation: Adjacent but not digital-game intent; evidence of query ambiguity.

queries.intentAssessment: Mostly discovery and age-fit screening for game options; close age/adventure variants belong on one guide. Results are not a representative or complete SERP sample.

queries: "learning games that don't feel like school" for kids

observedResults.title: The Best Science Learning Games That Actually Teach
observedResults.observation: Selection/explanation framing around game mechanics; page includes older-child examples.

observedResults.title: Educational resources to use at home
observedResults.observation: Government parent guidance on play; listed ideas focus mostly on younger children, so age transfer is limited.

observedResults.title: Supporting Children’s Learning Through Play
observedResults.observation: General parent guidance about structured/unstructured play, not a tween game catalogue.

queries.intentAssessment: Related explanatory intent: what playful learning can look like and how to choose activities that do not resemble drills. Keep as a substantial section in the age/game-selection guide; do not claim that fun proves learning.

"alternatives to passive screen time" kids games

observedResults.title: Digital media: Promoting healthy screen use in school-aged children and adolescents
observedResults.observation: Paediatric guidance emphasizes routines, age-appropriate content, educational/active/social use, and monitoring for interference.

observedResults.title: Discovering Digital at Primary: Back to School guide for parents
observedResults.observation: Family advice about purposeful use, co-op/skill-building options, alternatives, and shared rules.

queries.intentAssessment: Family media choice/routine intent, distinct from finding an educational game. A separate practical guide has independent value.

limits: Search-result observations are dated snapshots, not full result pages or exhaustive rankings.
The search service did not report locale, complete result counts, impressions, volume, traffic, conversion, or AI answers/citations.
No keyword volume, rank, demand size, user interview, product availability, or educational outcome was measured.
